name: overclock
description: Overclock — Claude Code plugins that run your model past spec.

plugins.name: overclock-setup
plugins.description: Choose Overclock plugins without guesswork. A manual, report-only advisor that inventories installed packages and project instruction metadata, detects standalone overlap, blocks incompatible combinations, and returns exact proposed commands and minimal instruction diffs without executing or writing anything. User-level instruction inspection is explicit opt-in.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Stop losing working state. Warm resume with verified full-SHA drift anchors, durable workflow lessons, and a ledger of verified fixes share a confined, atomic memory helper. The startup hook reports parked state without injecting repository-controlled prose; writes never auto-commit.

plugins.name: learning-loop
plugins.description: A self-improvement loop for your agent. Corrections to agent behavior and standing workflow rules become durable, evidence-counted lessons in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md through a confined atomic helper. Its startup hook reports ledger availability without injecting file-controlled text. Standalone alternative to session-memory; do not install both.

plugins.name: natural-writing
plugins.description: Draft and revise multi-paragraph prose in the author's established voice. With no supplied voice, uses a plainspoken fallback house style while preserving factual claims, uncertainty, caveats, quotations, and deliberate punctuation. Optional visual revision reports are reconstruction-verified and explicit opt-in.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Get clear-eyed analysis instead of agreeable answers. Tests framing and settled decisions against evidence, alternatives, and risk; delegates material local-fact questions to a host-isolated read-only context with exact roots, hard source budgets, provenance, and prompt-injection defenses, or fails closed when isolation is unavailable.

plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Requirements elicitation as a discipline. Asks one material decision at a time, distinguishes facts from uncertain evidence, labels decision provenance, and refuses to hide high-impact choices inside delegated defaults. Produces a confirmed decision brief and stops; implementation and planning remain separate.

plugins.name: project-vocabulary
plugins.description: Keep one ubiquitous domain language per project. Applies CONCEPTS.md in conversation, proposes exact changes when routing fires implicitly, and writes only on an explicit add/update request or approval. A confined atomic helper protects the root glossary; workflow corrections stay with lessons-learned.

plugins.name: pr-feedback
plugins.description: Work through GitHub PR feedback in two explicit stages. The resolver fetches and centrally judges comments, applies authorized local fixes, and drafts replies but cannot mutate GitHub. A manual-only publisher can post an exact digest-locked plan after complete host, PR, head, source, and action preflight. Never commits, pushes, merges, rebases, or approves.

plugins.name: discipline-gates
plugins.description: Pre-action engineering gates backed by real evidence: leave red or characterization artifacts uncommitted before edits, mutation-check selected behavior through an integrity-checked transactional restore, and recover defensive-code intent from untrusted history plus current-state proof before weakening it.

plugins.name: debugging-discipline
plugins.description: Systematic diagnosis for bugs that resist the ordinary red-test path. Establishes the safest useful observation loop, fails soft when reproduction is unavailable, minimizes the failure, and tests 1-5 credible hypotheses with predictions and proportionate noisy-evidence rules. Diagnosis is read-only unless implementation is also authorized.
